A VWAP-reclaim re-entry after a sub-VWAP short-trap ('this was a good opportunity to buy back in') is discussed only retrospectively as self-coaching about keeping stocks on radar, with no runnable entry taught â€” recorded as an unpromoted mention, not a separate strategy.

element_inventory: PRECONDITION: double inside bar setup on the daily chart
PRECONDITION: gap up near the prior high of day at the open
ENTRY: break above the previous (Friday) high of day = 18.74 / above previous day's closing price
ENTRY EXECUTION: take a starter position into the opening pullback (filled 261 shares @ ~18.43)
CONFIRMATION: needs volume to pick up and hold above 19 for continuation
TARGET: push back up into the 20s
EXIT (invalidation): jump out for a small loss when no follow-through over 19 / thin volume
strategies.entry_summary: Daily-chart double inside bar setup; enter a starter position on the opening pullback anticipating a breakout above the prior (Friday) high of day / previous day's close, targeting a push back into the 20s.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit for a small loss when there is no follow-through above the breakout level (briefly poked above 19 and prior close but volume was too thin); gestural exit, no fixed level taught.
strategies.name: double_inside_bar_daily_breakout

element_inventory: PRECONDITION: pre-market gap up that spikes, then trades sideways/consolidates into the open (biggest potential for a gap-and-go)
ENTRY LEVEL: opening range breakout level = high of the first 5-minute candle (VCIG = 3.94)
ENTRY EXECUTION: take a starter position as it breaks out above the ORB level
FILTER: ability to break ABOVE VWAP is the telltale sign of a bigger gap-and-go; stocks that reject VWAP at the open (NUWE, Lucy) lack follow-through â€” avoid/manage risk
SELECTION: NUWE never got above its ORB level; Lucy poked only 7 cents above then came straight back â€” no-follow-through breakouts fail
EXIT: scale profits into the initial spike (420s)
EXIT SIGNAL: take profits when consolidating above VWAP forms lower highs (bearish â€” consolidation is often the top of the move)
strategies.entry_summary: Gap-and-go opening range breakout: on a pre-market gapper that spikes then consolidates sideways into the open, take a starter position on the break above the opening range breakout level (high of the first 5-minute candle, e.g. 3.94).
strategies.exit_summary: Scale out profits into the initial spike (420s/440s), then take remaining profits as price consolidates above VWAP and starts forming lower highs (bearish signal that the consolidation is often the top before a fade back under VWAP toward low of day).
strategies.name: gap_and_go_opening_range_breakout
